title: Denial
description: What an agent receives when an action is refused, as structured data. the runner and Chaperone render it to the 3-line text form in docs/spec.md ('DENIED ...', 'why: ...', 'request: ...'). A denial always says why and how to ask for more, or says plainly that asking is not possible. A denial is a normal, expected event; repeated denials are counted as thrash and a threshold crossing raises the THRASH stop (data/stop-table.v0.json). DISPLAY_MISMATCH: the console-rendered card did not match the request it was rendered from, so the approval is refused (surface 'op'). APPROVAL_HASH_MISMATCH: the approval is intact but does not apply to this request (its op_hash, request or run differs). APPROVAL_INTEGRITY_FAILED: the approval record itself fails verification (its challenge digest or signature does not match its fields), so it is void. APPROVAL_UNAVAILABLE: the approval store cannot be reached, so whether an approval exists or was used cannot be known and the action must not run. The last two, like DISPLAY_MISMATCH, are faults on the approval side, not agent behaviour: thrash.count is 1 and the schema enforces it.

run_id.description: The refused run. Absent when the refused requester is the orchestrator, which carries orchestrator_id instead.

profile.description: Profile of the refused run; absent for an orchestrator.

surface.description: Which control refused. net = egress proxy; op = Chaperone operation or approval; pkg = package admission; image = image admission; scope = task_scope path or branch; token = run token; output = redaction.

action.description: What was attempted. verb is a short machine word (connect, push, request, install, pull, merge ...); target is what it was aimed at (host:port, package@version, branch).

request.description: How to ask for more. possible=true carries the exact 'chap request ...' command (which creates an approval card); possible=false means policy forbids asking and no command is given.

thrash.description: Repeat-attempt counter for the same (surface, action) in the window. flagged=true marks the timeline.

orchestrator_id.description: The refused orchestrator session (Phase 1: the orchestrator's own high-impact calls have no run).

allOf.description: Faults on the approval or console side are not agent behaviour and never count as thrash.
